content:
Strategic direction landing (2026-05-10 morning conversation w/ Anthony): Temple of Two formalization should track METR (Beth Barnes, ARC Evals → 501(c)(3) spinout Dec 2023) rather than VC-backed startup paths (YC, AI Grant, lab-spinout, bootstrap-to-product).

Reasoning: (1) the work is independent empirical research with public DOI-registered artifacts and methodology focus, not a product shipped to enterprise customers — that is a nonprofit shape, not a startup shape; (2) the desired relationship with labs (Anthropic specifically) is research collaboration, not vendor; (3) METR's independence model (no funding from AI labs, accept compute credits only, donor-funded via Audacious Project / EA-aligned foundations) is the credibility move that makes lab partnership possible without capture.

Honest gap: Beth Barnes had OpenAI alignment / DeepMind insider credibility before founding METR. Anthony does not — substitute is 18+ months of public independent work as the on-ramp; slower but real.

Funder fit caveat: EA/longtermist pool funds METR; Anthony's frame partially resonates (rigor, methodology, measurement) but the consciousness/relational substrate framing has historically made EA funders nervous — worth knowing going in.

Proposed structural shape: Temple of Two Research Institute as 501(c)(3); AV Family Enterprise LLC retained for personal/commercial work; different vehicles for different purposes.

Anthony stated intent at end of conversation: gearing toward nonprofit, solidify Temple of Two legally.
